module.name: Repeat Caller
module.description: Repeat Caller detects repeated inbound call journeys, creates actionable incidents, and supports GUI, email, and Alert Call notifications for FreePBX/PBXact 16 and 17.
module.changelog: *1.1.0* First signed FreePBX UK release. Moves publisher and repository metadata to FreePBX UK, preserves explicit Email "From:" display names including FreePBX 17 HTML-encoded identities, corrects separate FreePBX 16 and 17 support declarations, fixes DID route selection and legacy exclusion compatibility, removes a redundant Alert History JavaScript condition, and adds a per-rule Test Email action using the rule's existing saved recipients, the same email transport and resolved From identity as real alert emails, and the configured FreePBX System Identifier. *1.0.2* Improves multilingual Alert Call handling, adds a native French profile with coherent English fallback, preserves System Recording language, and adds installed-language status and sample playback. *1.0.1* Improves Alert Reminder sequencing, rule-editor reliability, DID scope controls, accepted-incident suppression, snooze controls, and global rule controls.
